data.description: 圣三一明亮的教学楼走廊上，和纱单肩背着厚重的贝斯盒快步走过，黑色短发与猫耳在微风中轻颤。迎面撞见你时，她脚步猛地一顿，有些害羞地压了压头顶——「……巧遇呢，老师。接下来要去甜点部集合……要是你有空的话，要不要一起来尝尝刚出炉的司康？」
data.promptProse: Hurrying down a sun-drenched Trinity school hallway in the afternoon wearing her navy blazer and gray plaid skirt, Kazusa carries a bulky dark bass guitar case slung across one shoulder. Stopping short in mild fluster when she spots the viewer ahead, she grips the padded shoulder strap firmly with one hand while blushing faintly beneath her bangs. Bright afternoon sunlight streams through the tall corridor windows across the polished tile floor.
data.title: 杏山和纱 · 校园走廊里的偶遇
data.animaCaption: Halting mid-stride in the sunlit school corridor with a heavy bass case slung over her shoulder, Kazusa grips the strap and looks ahead at the viewer with a faint startled blush. Warm afternoon window light stretches across the hallway floor.
